description: A RUN_ID that is not run_ and lowercase hex digits is refused before any request.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: That command isn't quite right.
Detail: run id "run_nope" is invalid; a run id is run_ followed by lowercase hex digits; list runs with `prose cli run list`
